nodes.question: What must farmers do to adapt to disrupted ecosystems?
nodes.answer: Farmers must adapt by utilizing knowledge, resources, and supportive policies.
nodes.paragraph: Disrupted ecosystems affect polli - nators and balance (Jamieson et al. 2012 ; Nakweya 2023 ; Trunschke et al. 2024 ). Farmers must adapt with knowl - edge, resources, and supportive policies (Baumgard et al. 2012 ; Belmin et al. 2023 ; Chimi et al. 2022 ; Grossi et al. 2019 ; Renaudeau et al. 2012 ; Rizzo et al. 2024 ; Skend i et al. 2021 ; Stringer et al. 2020 ; Teixeira et al. 2013 ; Verma et al. 2020 ). Despite many studies on agroecological practices and sustainable agriculture, gaps persist, such as fragmented analyses and a lack of interdisciplinary perspectives (Boutagayout et al. 2023 ; Wezel et al. 2014 , 2020 ). These gaps fragmented analyses, a lack of interdisciplinary perspectives, and an overlook of emerging regions and innovative approaches beckon for deeper inquiry.
